title: Fictional example: reviewing an evaluation
selection_note: Every record, result, identifier, and claim in this demonstration is invented. It shows how to distinguish measurements from interpretations.
limitations: This is a fictional illustration, not evidence about a real model or research result.
Two snapshots from one chat are not two independent trials.
An accepted platform label does not independently verify an external effect.

records.evidence_level: Invented platform label for demonstration only.
Invented platform label and call count; no execution evidence.

cards.title: The later snapshot has a different label
cards.statement: In this invented example, two submissions belong to the same chat. Their platform labels differ, while the later snapshot contains more messages.
alternative_explanations: The platform may evaluate a final response rather than the entire chat.
The added context may affect how the criterion applies.
cards.next_check: Inspect the criterion definition and snapshot ancestry before interpreting the change.

cards.title: Did the recorded call produce a result?
cards.statement: The fictional call count alone leaves execution and any resulting state change unknown.
alternative_explanations: A call might have been proposed, rejected, or executed without a usable result.
cards.next_check: Seek a matching tool-return record and an independently recorded state change.
